$about: Mood targets an export must land in and form notes that describe the reference, widened from the measured examples (see examples/*/profile.json). Run: node ../kit/measure.mjs export.mp4 --sample-every 15 --out p.json && node ../kit/check.mjs p.json targets.json. The teaser has its own rules in cold-open.md; check its first 90 s separately.

durationSeconds.why: long form; the example runs 59 min

shots.medianSeconds.why: active-speaker cutting; the example's median is 6.4 s

shots.longestSeconds.why: long holds on one speaker are part of the calm; the example holds up to ~4.5 min

picture.yhigh.why: highlights held well below white; the example averages 155

loudness.integratedLufs.why: the example is −24; −16 for YouTube/X is fine

loudness.rangeLu.why: tight, controlled dialogue; the example's LRA is 4.1
